text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, Feb 11 - Bombay - No labour problems. Five vessels loading at berth, 20 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 6 waiting to discharge, 1 bunkering, 2 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Delays expected, containers 1-2 days, bulkers 8-10 days, general cargo 2-3 days. Calcutta - 14 Vessels discharging at berth, 7 loading at berth, 2 bunkering. 22 Vessels due (2 coking coal, 8 products tankers, 1 pulses, 6 containers, 1 ply-wood, 1 timber, 1 crude oil, 1iquid ammonia, 1 lash). Cochin - No labour problems. Three vessels discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 2 small vessels at dry-dock, 1 other at shipyard jetty for repairs/fitting, 1 awaiting orders after discharging cement 9/2.

Chennai (Madras) - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 dredger dry-docked/under repair. 39 Vessels due by 11/2 of which 13 general cargo, 1 edible oil, 6 coal, 11 containers, 1 ore, 1 phosphoric acid, 1 wheat, 2 scrap, 3 fertiliser. Mormugao - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 2 loading at anchorage, 2 discharging at berth. 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 2 under repair/dry-docked, 2 awaiting orders. 12 Vessels due (8 ore, 1 alumina, 1 molasses, 1 naphtha, 1 phosphoric acid) with the following delays, ore 5-6 days, alumina/molasses 1-2 days, napht/phosphoric acid 1 day.

Kandla - Eight vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. 3 Vessels in harbour under arrest, 3 tankers. 16 Vessels waiting, 17 due with 6-7 days delay expected. Mangalore - No labour problems. Six vessels loading/discharging at berth, 2 awaiting berth, 1 under arrest, 10 due with 3-4 days delay expected. Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. One tanker waiting at chorage to load, 3 tankers/iron ore vessels due, with 2-3 days berthing delay expected. 6-8 Days berthing delay expected for fertiliser/raw materials vessels. Paradip - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge. 7 Vessels due of which 2 chrome, 2 coal, 1 fertiliser, 1 oil, 1 gas/chemicals. Up to 1 days delay expected.

Tuticorin - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 3 due with 1-2 days delay expected. Visakhapatnam - 11 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth. 13 Vessels due (1 export, hr plates. 12 Import vessels, 1 urea, 1 wheat, 3 coking coal, 1 containers, 2 phosphoric acid, 1 liquid ammonia, 1 iron ore fines, 1 petcoke, 1 caustic soda) with the following delays expected, hr plates/iron ore fines/petcoke 7-8 days, urea 1-2 days, coking coal 5-6 days, containers/phosphoric acid/liquid ammonia/caustic soda up to 1 day.

MAURITIUS, Feb 11 - Port Louis - Port labour working normally. Two container vessels berthed discharging/loading, 3 general cargo vessels discharging, 1 vessel at buoys discharging bagged rice into lighters. Fishing port - 11 Vessels berthed, no idle vessels, 1 at outer anchorage awaiting berth to discharge general cargo.

SIERRA LEONE, Feb 10 - Freetown - No labour problems. For security reasons, vessels must endeavour to be in/out of port before 19.00 hrs. One sugar discharger loading at berth, 1 cargo vessel anchored under arrest. 5 Vessels due of which 2 container dischargers, 1 container/vehicles discharger, 1 aid cargo discharger, 1 bulk wheat discharger/mill feed loader, no delays expected.

SINGAPORE, Feb 12 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 9 Container vessels berthed. Eppel terminal - 14 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 5 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 3 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 1 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessel berthed. Oil terminal, SBM buoy - 26 Tankers berthed, minimal berthing delays at all terminals/ports/buoys.

SOUTH KOREA, Feb 11 - Inchon - 68 Vessels in port (43 berthed, 25 anchored) of which berthed, 7 general cargo, 5 logs, 4 containers, 4 pig-iron, 2 pulp, 2 steel, 2 corn, 2 ply-wood, 2 wheat, 2 scrap, 1 timber, 1 aluminium hydroxide, 1 oak leaves, 1 ingots, 1 clay, 1 granite, 1 cotton seed meal, 1 cars, 1 fertiliser, 1 fuel oil, 1 silica sand. Vessels anchored, 6 containers, 3 scrap, 3 cars, 3 coils, 2 wheat, 1 soya beans, 1 raw sugar, 1 logs, 1 cotton seed meal, 1 general cargo, 1 pulp, 1 ply-wood, 1 copper, approx. 2 days delay expected. Busan - 172 Vessels in port (53 berthed, 119 anchored including 58 laid-up of which berthed, 36 general cargo, 9 containers, 5 scrap, 3 coal. 61 General cargo vessels awaiting berths, approx. 2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 39 Vessels in port (28 berthed, 11 anchored) of which berthed discharging, 5 scrap, 3 billets, 3 coils, 2 pipes, 1 fertiliser, 1 chrome 1 logs, 1 coke, 1 h-beams. 10 Steel vessels loading, 11 vessels awaiting berths, approx. 2-3 days delay expected. Ulsan - 24 Vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging, 3 chemicals, 3 feed meal, 1 crude oil, 1 coal, 1 cement, 1 urea, 1 mono-ethyl glycol, 1 fertiliser, 1 tallow, 1 propylene, 1 liquefied petroleum gas, 1 normal paraffin, 1 wood-chips. Vessels loading, 2 ammonium sulphate, 2 resin, 1 diesel oil, 1 chemicals, 1 white oil, no berthing delays expected. Masan - Seven vessels in port (5 berthed, 2 anchored) of which berthed and discharging, 2 scrap, 1 pig iron, 1 tapioca, 1 slabs, 2 vessels awaiting berths, approx. 1 days delay expected. SPAIN, Feb 9 - Sagunto - 22 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ros discharging/loading general cargo. 16 Vessels discharging (11 steel products, 1 potatoes, 1 machinery, 1 lead, 1 fertiliser). 2 Loading (1 cement, 1

SRI LANKA, Feb 11 - 15 Vessels loading at berth (10 containers, 5 essential services). 17 Discharging at berth (3 bagged sugar, 10 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 1 rice, 1 cement, 1 fertiliser). 11 Vessels due of which 7 containers, 1 onions, 1 vehicles, 1 bulk cement, 1 steel. Delays, conventional vessels 2-3 days, container vessels 1-2 days. Galle - No vessels operating. Trincomalee - One vessel loading at berth.
